GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (18 Jan 46) GC
(SCAPIN-618)
18 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Japanese Diplomatic and Consular Members and Others.
1. Reference is made to letter, C.L.O. No. 48 (5.2), dated 5 January 1946, subject as above.
2. The request of the Imperial Japanese Government for repatriation of Japanese diplomatic and consular personnel has been brought to the attention of the appropriate authorities in Washington without reference to other Japanese civilians abroad.
3. Further action concerning the repatriation of Japanese civilians abroad is being held in abeyance pending receipt by this headquarters of the lists mentioned in reference letter.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel,A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
